newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares rebound on index-related stocks.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares rebound on index-related stocks.

text.p: Shanghai B shares rose on a technical rebound on Tuesday due to support for stocks which have a heavy weighting in the stock index, but follow-up buying was limited amid poor market sentiment, brokers said.
The index gained 0.255 points or 0.54 percent to 47.135 points on volume of 5.0 million shares worth $2.3 million. Of 41 B shares, 35 traded with 12 up, nine flat and 14 down.
Brokers attributed today's gains to support buying for major stocks but said a further rise is unlikely with follow-up buying limited due to the gloomy market mood.

Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development, another market giant, traded the most with heavy selling above $0.900 despite institutional support, ending unchanged at $0.880, off an intra-day high of $0.908 with 1.1 million shares traded.
Shanghai Forever was the biggest loser due to its poor results, falling $0.010 or 8.47 percent to $0.108 on volume of 25,000 shares.
Shanghai A shares tumbled late in the session due to profit-taking and unwinding selling, and the market is likely to fall further in the short term, brokers said.

Shanghai Tyre Rubber, one of biggest B share firms listed in Shanghai, was the star on a trade of 10,000 shares just ahead of the close, jumping $0.024 or 9.91 percent to $0.266 on volume of 111,100 shares.

"It seemed some institutions tried to support the index by buying stocks which have a relatively big influence in the index, but investors don't believe they will be able to reverse the bearish tone," one broker said.
"The market will slip further in the coming days," a second broker said.

The A index dipped 18.460 points or 1.86 percent to 976.227 points on volume of 397.2 million shares worth 3.7 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index fell 36.787 points or 1.48 percent to 2451.859 points.
Shenma Industry was the biggest loser on institutional selling, falling 0.99 yuan or 9.71 percent to 9.20 yuan on volume of 2.1 million shares.
